## load

```{r setup}
load("../DATA/data1.Rdata")

behrule = list(
  cue = c(
    "AJ", "AK", "AL", 
    "BJ", "BK", "BL", 
    "CJ", "CK", "CL", 
    "DJ", "DK", "DL", 
    "EJ", "EK", "EL", 
    "FJ", "FK", "FL"
  ),
  rsp = c(
    "AJ", "AK", "AL", 
    "BJ", "BK", "BL", 
    "CJ", "CK", "CL", 
    "DJ", "DK", "DL", 
    "EJ", "EK", "EL", 
    "FJ", "FK", "FL"
  )
)
colnames = list(
  subid = "Subject", block = "Block", trial = "Trial",
  object = c("Object_1", "Object_2", "Object_3"),
  reward = c("Reward_1", "Reward_2", "Reward_3"),
  action = "Action",
  exinfo = c("SetSize")
)
source("./functions_plot.R")
```


## test

```{r}
multiRL.model <- multiRL::run_m(
  data = data[data[, "Subject"] == 1, ],
  behrule = behrule,
  colnames = colnames,
  params = list(
    free = list(
      alpha = 0.6
    ),
    fixed = list(beta = 25, delta = 0),
    constant = list(Q0 = 0.33, reset = 0.33)
  ),
  priors = list(),
  settings = list(
    name = "TD",
    mode = "fitting",
    estimate = "MLE",
    policy = "on"
  )
)

multiRL.summary <- multiRL::summary(multiRL.model)
```

## creat

```{r}
TD <- function(params){
  
  params <- list(
    free = list(alpha = params[1]),
    fixed = list(beta = 25, delta = 0),
    constant = list(Q0 = 0.33, reset = 0.33)
  )

  multiRL.model <- multiRL::run_m(
    data = data,
    behrule = behrule,
    colnames = colnames,
    params = params,
    funcs = funcs,
    priors = priors,
    settings = settings
  )
  
  assign(x = "multiRL.model", value = multiRL.model, envir = multiRL.env)
  return(.return_result(multiRL.model))
}

```

## recovery

```{r}
reticulate::use_condaenv(condaenv = "tf-gpu", required = TRUE)
```

```{r}
recovery <- multiRL::rcv_d(
  estimate = "ABC",
  
  data = data,
  behrule = behrule,
  colnames = colnames,

  models = list(TD),
  priors = list(
    list(
      alpha = function(x) {stats::rbeta(n = 1, shape1 = 2, shape2 = 2)}
    )
  ),
  settings = list(list(name = "TD")),
  
  lowers = list(c(0)),
  uppers = list(c(1)),
  control = list(
    core = 10, sample = 100, 
    # LBI
    iter = 100,
    # SBI
    train = 1000, 
    # ABC
    reduction = "PLS", tol = 0.1, ncomp = 6,
    # RNN
    info = c("Object_1", "Object_2", "Object_3", "Action", "SetSize"),
    loss = "MDN", L = 2, check = FALSE
  )
)

save(recovery, file = "../OUTPUT/recovery.TD.Rdata")
```

```{r}
replay.recovery <- multiRL::rpl_e(
  result = recovery,

  data = data,
  behrule = behrule,
  colnames = colnames,
  
  models = list(TD),
  settings = list(name = c("TD")),

  omit = c("data", "funcs")
)
  
save(replay.recovery, file = "../OUTPUT/replay.recovery.TD.Rdata")

p <- plot(x = replay.recovery)
ggplot2::ggsave(
  plot = p$param[[1]]$alpha, filename = "../TD_alpha.png",
  width = 5, height = 5
)
rm(p)
```

## fit

```{r}
fitting <- multiRL::fit_p(
  estimate = "MLE",
  algorithm = "NLOPT_GN_MLSL",
  
  data = data,
  behrule = behrule,
  colnames = colnames,

  models = list(TD),
  priors = list(
    list(
      alpha = function(x) {stats::rbeta(n = 1, shape1 = 2, shape2 = 2)}, 
      beta = function(x) {stats::rexp(n = 1, rate = 0.1)}
    )
  ),
  settings = list(list(name = "TD")),
  
  lowers = list(c(0, 0)),
  uppers = list(c(1, 50)),
  control = list(
    core = 10, sample = 100, 
    # LBI
    iter = 100,
    # SBI
    train = 1000,
    # ABC
    reduction = "PCA", #ncomp = 6,
    # RNN
    info = c("Object_1", "Object_2", "Object_3", "Action", "SetSize")
  )
)

save(fitting, file = "../OUTPUT/fitting.TD.Rdata")
```

```{r}
replay.fitting <- multiRL::rpl_e(
  result = fitting,

  data = data,
  behrule = behrule,
  colnames = colnames,
  
  models = list(TD),
  settings = list(name = c("TD")),

  omit = c("funcs")
)

#p <- plot(replay.fitting)
#ggplot2::ggsave(filename = "../TD_fitting.png", width = 40, height = 5)

save(replay.fitting, file = "../OUTPUT/replay.fitting.TD.Rdata")
```

## plot

```{r}
#load("../OUTPUT/replay.fitting.TD.Rdata")

data_fitting <- base::do.call(
  base::rbind,
  base::lapply(
    replay.fitting[[1]],
    function(subject) {
      subject[["multiRL.summary"]]@data
    }
  )
)

p <- extract_setsize_history(data_fitting)
plot_setsize_analysis(p)

ggplot2::ggsave(filename = "../SetSize_Effect_TD.png", width = 8, height = 6)
rm(p)
```
